title: Macrophage Signal Transduction Simulation Using Computational Models
author: Zhao, Popel

steps.title: Open and load model script
steps.instruction: In MATLAB’s “Current Folder” window, double‑click the file named analysis_Fig7_virtualmacs.m to open it, then run the first section of the script to load the ODE model.

steps.title: Generate virtual single‑cell population
steps.instruction: Run the second section of the script to create a sample population of 100 virtual macrophage cells by re‑assigning new values to a set of 42 parameters that control production and degradation of 10 modeled species (5 intracellular regulators and 5 cytokines); this procedure is repeated 100 times to generate 100 distinct parameterizations.

steps.title: Plot baseline M1‑M2 phenotypes under hypoxia
steps.instruction: Run the third section of the script (starting at line 163) to plot the time‑dependent M1‑M2 phenotypes of the 100 virtual macrophages in hypoxia, showing 100 trajectories of relative M1 scores, M2 scores, and M1/M2 scores; also plot the reference model’s phenotype (black bold line) for comparison.

steps.title: Plot phenotypes with STAT3/STAT6 interventions
steps.instruction: Run the fourth section of the script (starting at line 253) to plot the time‑dependent M1‑M2 phenotypes of the 100 virtual macrophages under hypoxia plus simulated interventions targeting STAT3 or STAT6, represented as decreased dephosphorylation rates; include the reference model’s phenotype (black bold line) for comparison.
